stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet, an iron nail, and a plastic comb. Rohan brings the magnet near each object. The nail is attracted. The comb is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

options.text: The nail is made of a magnetic material; the comb is not.
The comb is made of a magnetic material; the nail is not.
Both are magnetic because Rohan used a magnet.
Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.

teacher.key_rationale: A magnet attracts magnetic materials. The nail is attracted, so it is magnetic. The comb is not attracted, so it is non-magnetic.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source cylinders into a bar magnet with iron nail and plastic comb.
